headline: Mercedes debuts its ADUO turbo on Antonelli's car in Las Vegas
body: Antonelli will run the upgraded turbo this weekend, with Toto Wolff expecting a relatively small gain. Russell stays on his current specification: he has already used five turbos, so another would cost him a five-place grid penalty.

headline: Alonso will race the Dakar Rally for Aston Martin in January
body: Alonso returns to Dakar seven years after finishing 13th with Toyota, with Marc Coma as co-driver in an Aston Martin Dreadnought run by Prodrive. He keeps his Formula 1 seat for 2027. The rally runs from 9 to 23 January in Portugal and Morocco.
